cohort: A 36-year-old woman with type 2 diabetes mellitus and 1-year of primary infertility, diagnosed with heterotopic cervical pregnancy at 7.4 weeks of gestation following oral ovulation induction cycles and intrauterine insemination.
finding: Laser ablation appears to be a minimally invasive and successful procedure for the treatment of heterotopic cervical pregnancy, preserving the intrauterine pregnancy and leading to the delivery of a healthy infant.
gest_age: 7.4 weeks at diagnosis, 36 0/7 weeks at delivery
